data.name: Amlahan
data.gender_notes: Amlahan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'malaha', which means 'to give' or 'to provide'. This name is commonly given to boys, signifying the act of giving, generosity, and support. The name Amlahan carries the meaning “Giver, Provider” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amlahan usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, provider and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the concept of giving and providing in Islam, reflecting the importance of helping others and being a source of sustenance and support.
data.etymology: Amlahan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amlahan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
